text:
jordan: Heads-up — seeing remote_write timeouts from prometheus-eu-west pods since ~10:40 UTC. Scraper logs show 'http2: stream closed' and 'unexpected EOF'. Queue is growing and tail-latency spikes. Also noticed a big cardinality jump on gpu_task_labels after last night’s model-allocator deploy. Can folks triage? :eyes:

infra-bot: [ALERT] prometheus-eu-west-remote-write-down firing (firing for 2m). Summary: remote_write request errors > 5% over 1m.

anya: thanks, looking. quick question — did the serviceMonitor change for gpu-exporter land in the same deploy? that was when we added 'task_id' label into relabel config iirc. adding high-card labels to metrics would explain the spike.

sam: pulling logs now. kubectl logs prometheus-eu-west-0 -n monitoring --tail=200 shows repeated lines:
```
level=error ts=2025-11-02T10:41:12.123Z caller=queue_manager.go:195 component=remote level=error err="http2: stream closed"
level=warn ts=2025-11-02T10:41:17.456Z caller=queue_manager.go:210 component=remote msg="remote_write queue full, dropping samples"
```
looks like remote side kept closing streams, and our queue_config is saturated.

lucy: can we safely drop pod_ip and task_id at ingest? temp mitigation: add metric_relabel_configs to drop those labels for gpu_task_labels and gpu_metrics.* metrics. e.g. in prometheus config: 
```yaml
metric_relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ['__name__']
    regex: 'gpu_task_labels|gpu_metrics.*'
    action: keep
  - regex: 'pod_ip|task_id'
    action: labeldrop
```
that will reduce cardinality quickly while we root-cause.

oliver: also double-check remote_write config — remote_timeout and queue_config sizing. currently remote_timeout: 30s and queue_config: {max_samples_per_send: 500, batch_send_deadline: 5s, max_shards: 5}. With higher cardinality those shard/sample params can choke. Suggest bumping max_shards to 10 and lowering max_samples_per_send to 250 while we drop labels. Example: 
```yaml
remote_write:
- url: https://remote-storage.example.com/api/v1/write
  remote_timeout: 60s
  queue_config:
    max_shards: 10
    max_samples_per_send: 250
    batch_send_deadline: 10s
```
This reduces per-send payload size and gives more parallelism.

anya: fwiw we just rolled model-allocator which added `task_id` to its kube annotations and our servicemonitor relabeler used to_prometheus_labels: true — so labels flowed into metrics. will open PR to stop exporting task_id.

sam: repro steps for future: run a test job that annotates with unique id and watch cardinality with grafana panel 'top labels by series count'. worth adding an alert: series_count_delta > X for 5m on prometheus target.

jordan: agreed. immediate plan: (1) lucy to push metric_relabel drop for pod_ip/task_id as hotfix (2) oliver to apply temporary remote_write queue tweaks (3) anya to revert/patch serviceMonitor relabel in model-allocator PR (4) sam to add dashboard/alert for series count spike. I'll own the rollout coordination.

lucy: pushing hotfix to monitoring kustomize now, will patch prometheus-eu-west and watch.

oliver: applying queue changes, scaling max_shards -> 10. watching wire.

sam: adding a one-off grafana panel and alert rule — will post links when done.

anya: PR opened to remove task_id from exported labels: https://github.com/redwood/model-allocator/pull/764 (wip).

jordan: nice. if remote-side keeps closing streams we might also need to talk to the remote ingest team — their logs showed occasional 503s earlier. tagging @platform-telemetry to keep them in loop. :phone:

infra-bot: [INFO] incident ticket created: INC-2025-1123 (prometheus remote_write timeout / cardinality spike). Assigned: eng-sre.

jordan: OK let's reconvene in 15m for status. thanks all. :thumbsup:
